chapter.title: The Creation
chapter.verse: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.
And the earth was without form, and void; and darkness Or, upon the face of the deep.was upon the face of the deep.
And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.
For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son (größte Liebe).
For God sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world John 12:47.
The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
